p=Path('poc11.php')

trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/mb_ereg_search_xxx.phpt","function":"<global>","line":10,"var":"look_for","code":"mb_ereg_search_init( $str, $look_for, $opt );","note":"The mb_ereg_search_init API accepts a caller-provided regex and forwards it to the engine during initialization."},
 {"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_init)","line":1551,"var":"arg_pattern","code":"if ((MBREX(search_re) = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, option, MBREX(current_mbctype), syntax)) == NULL) {","note":"This is the admission point where the supplied pattern is compiled into the internal Oniguruma object."},
 {"step":3,"file":"oniguruma/src/oniguruma.h","function":"<global>","line":505,"var":"ONIG_SYN_OP2_QMARK_PERL_SUBEXP_CALL","code":"#define ONIG_SYN_OP2_QMARK_PERL_SUBEXP_CALL     (1U<<27) /* (?R), (?&name)... */","note":"Perl subexpression recursion is enabled in the syntax, so recursive groups can be represented in the AST."},
 {"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"switch (NODE_TYPE(node)) {","note":"The compiler's emptiness analysis recursively traverses user-controlled nodes when a quantifier body can be empty."},
 {"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4912,"var":"NODE_IS_RECURSION(node)","code":"if (NODE_IS_RECURSION(node)) { return BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_REC; }","note":"Recursive nodes in a repeated body are classified as BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_REC, the special case implicated by the issue."},
 {"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5458,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"A zero-minimum recursive repeat therefore reaches the vulnerable quantifier tuning path."},
 {"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regexec.c","function":"STACK_EMPTY_CHECK_MEM_REC","line":2063,"var":"execution stack","code":"#define STACK_EMPTY_CHECK_MEM_REC(isnull,sid,s,reg) do { ... }","note":"The produced empty-repeat metadata later drives the recursion-aware runtime stack walk where the memory safety issue occurs."}
]
Path('candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace))
